portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: *.my.site.com host, Salesforce Lightning/Aura page shell, register-view?c__r=Arcus_BE_Public_Register

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26; Salford's planning committee is called a regulatory panel. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: PA/YYYY/NNNN. Arcus record ids (18-character Salesforce ids) are separate and cannot be built from the reference.

browser_route.note: Open the register in a browser and search for the reference. PlanIt's applics url (…/pr/s/planning-application/<18-char id>) is a record deep link where PlanIt has the case.

quirks.summary: Arcus (Salesforce Experience Cloud) register with no anonymous API surface; the page is a Lightning shell, not data.
quirks.detail: bot_protection is deliberately null: nothing challenged the client (Cloudflare fronts the host, passive at the time). The obstacle is architectural, and the skill does not reverse-engineer the Arcus managed-package controllers.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the browser route. PlanIt's applics url is a ready record deep link where it has one.

quirks.summary: The site's robots.txt names be.salford.gov.uk as the canonical host for the same register (sitemap lines); PlanIt uses salfordcitycouncil.my.site.com.
quirks.workaround: Either host should reach the same Salesforce site; be.salford.gov.uk was not requested in this run.

pacing.note: Two requests to the register host at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 (register page, robots.txt) with no 429 or challenge. Nothing was attempted on the Arcus controllers.

robots.note: Default Salesforce communities robots.txt: 'User-agent: *' with 'Allow: /', disallowing only the password-reset path.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave the Arcus register URL. One GET confirmed Arcus: a Lightning/Aura shell with no register data. robots.txt fetched. PlanIt's applics records gave PA/2026/1225 and PA/2026/1230 with /pr/s/planning-application/<id> links. No download attempted: Arcus is browser-only. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id.
